A_required_SQL_prefix.reason: Existing first-enable reference iteration reaches artifact/MinIO slots before signer slots. Actual source importers use original capture head/grant before MinIO and signer subdomains. Do NOT acquire MinIO source locks and then newly acquire capture. The NEW signer observation provides an explicit prefix check; normal Recheck refuses if that exact transaction has not invoked the prefix.
A_required_SQL_prefix.assembly: In A preparedConfigMutationReadiness.Recheck, after actual global installation/admin authority and before the ordinary resource Recheck loop/MinIO source/fence acquisition, scan prepared observations for this concrete interface and call it using the SAME ctx/tx/already-authoritative now. Then run the UNCHANGED ordinary checks and final clock/current-state checks. All3 signer aliases point at one observation; repeated prefix calls on same tx are idempotent with deadline/context/local-pin/monotonic-time checks. No generic caller-supplied prefix success is accepted by the C factory.
A_required_SQL_prefix.pseudocode: for _, o := range p.checks { if prefix, ok := o.check.(interface { RecheckOriginalSignerPrefix(context.Context, *sql.Tx, time.Time) error }); ok { if prefix.RecheckOriginalSignerPrefix(ctx, tx, now) != nil { return fail() } } }\n// Then the original complete o.check.Recheck loop, fixed-risk/deadline comparisons and final original SQL clock checks.
A_required_SQL_prefix.lock_order: Original active local admin -> capture installation-owner head/grant -> acceptance_record head/grant -> catalog_record head/grant. Existing signed source codecs/readOwnerLedger/ReadSigningResourceCandidate perform current revocation/signature/row-version checks, FOR SHARE only. Native HTTP/Kube work and separate DB transactions occur ONLY during Prepare outside the controlled SQL prefix.
A_required_SQL_prefix.no_unwired_pass: Without this A prefix integration, ordinary C signer Recheck latches failure BEFORE reading signer/capture SQL rows; it cannot silently pass merely because the interfaces are registered. D/A must integrate and test this hook before claiming lawful first enabling.

Two signer grants also share the same original plan/enrollment document/material SHA+revision and complete distinct bindings/histories. Each source retains its own independent purpose signature domain, current SQL head/grant and actual installed material verification.

actual_observation.original_window: Capture retains ORIGINAL signed Probe.Until and source Until; acceptance/catalog retain ORIGINAL ObservedSigningResource.Window(), including batch-lease/provider/source expiry. It never refreshes signed probe challenge/expiry, key/version, CapturedAt or native window on SQL recheck. Missing/expired/unreachable/native-invalid source gives an error and NO usable fresh observation.

Current capture+signer signatures/CAS/row versions/active revocation state are checked again in that same transaction; actual source/local token/material pins remain unchanged.
